scope: Board A findings 001, 002 and Board A portion of 012

blockers.001_afe_electrical: Prove microphone 25-kohm minimum resistive and 100-pF maximum capacitive loading, ADC pin absolute/recommended voltage and buffer drive across power states, and a deterministic four-channel coupling/filter topology with adjustable 96-kHz performance provision. Typical ADC impedance may be used only for nominal response, not as a guaranteed limit.
blockers.002_boot_hardware: Prove the selected flash command, ROM 30-MHz timing and voltage compatibility, boot-pad thresholds, reset/recovery hardware, and schematic-ready crystal and powered fixture connections. The FCB field profile must match ROM and flash semantics; generated binary and execution are R14.
blockers.012_a_load_power: Manufacturer-guaranteed TLV320ADC5140 AVDD/IOVDD current at four-channel 96 kHz and 128 BCLK/FSYNC is absent; imposed 50/5-mA ceilings require acceptance and R14 measurement. TPS62135 guaranteed minimum efficiency or maximum total conversion loss for 4.5-5.5 V, 350 mA and forced PWM is absent; 70% is an acceptance assumption, not a guaranteed thermal bound. Selected capacitor MPNs with guaranteed effective capacitance at bias/temperature/tolerance and selected inductors' hot Isat/DCR must be frozen; local buck and internal-DCDC stability/current peaks must be checked. Product-board effective theta-JA, enclosed local ambient and high-load LDO ground current are not guaranteed by the cited device tables; thermal screening is conditional. Upstream 5-V receiving/current-limit and fault-energy contract is a separate Board B/interface obligation, outside this Board A subtask.
blockers.012_a_startup: Freeze the all-rail POR gate and prove DCDC, LDO, ramp, reset and powered-off behavior by schematic-ready values and worst-case startup calculations.

requirements.requirement: Prove microphone 25-kohm minimum resistive and 100-pF maximum capacitive loading, ADC pin absolute/recommended voltage and buffer drive across power states, and a deterministic four-channel coupling/filter topology with adjustable 96-kHz performance provision. Typical ADC impedance may be used only for nominal response, not as a guaranteed limit.
Measure the selected-harness four-channel 96-kHz noise, response, clipping/headroom, coupling corner and phase over operating conditions; adjust provided component/filter values before release.

Prove the selected flash command, ROM 30-MHz timing and voltage compatibility, boot-pad thresholds, reset/recovery hardware, and schematic-ready crystal and powered fixture connections. The FCB field profile must match ROM and flash semantics; generated binary and execution are R14.
Freeze factory and field recovery, security/fuse and update policy where it determines strap, debug, interface or fixture hardware.
requirements.closure_evidence: state/rt1062_pin_resource_map.json r4a_board_a_selection.boot_straps: V1 unfused internal boot, ROM UART fixture for factory and field service, no OTA or OTP fuses; NXP RM Rev 4 pp.197-200 and CEC Rev 4 Table 22 static strap corner calculation.

requirements.requirement: Generate and inspect the exact 512-byte RT1062 FCB/LUT encoding, program the production image and test native boot from the selected flash on implemented hardware.
Exercise dead-flash recovery and programmed-image update/security paths on implemented hardware.
Measure crystal startup, USB clock tolerance and physical boot-pad/fixture levels on implemented hardware.

Freeze a calculated Board A 96-kHz/flash engineering load budget with explicit reserve for typical-only device currents; prove rail/receiving-envelope corners, I/O and transient allocation, capacitor/inductor derating, regulator thermal and fault margins. Never treat TI/NXP measured or typical current as a guaranteed maximum.
Freeze the all-rail POR gate and prove DCDC, LDO, ramp, reset and powered-off behavior by schematic-ready values and worst-case startup calculations.
Measure actual 96-kHz and flash-mode rail consumption, rail ramp/POR waveforms, load transients and populated-board thermal behavior against the frozen engineering budget.
Close Board B input protection, 5-V source, connector/current/return-drop, inrush and fault contract in the global R4 scope.
